scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed Empathy throughout the call, ignoring two major customer panic moments regarding being stranded at Heathrow airport at turn 1 and turn 45 with cold, dismissive procedural deflections.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent refused to take ownership of an emergency resolution, declining to provide manual supervisor eSIM authorization, refusing to reimburse third-party airport SIM expenses, and instructing the stranded customer to manage the crisis unassisted.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly ended the call at turn 60 while the customer was still mid-sentence asking for contingency guidance, failing to confirm customer understanding or provide an acceptable resolution.

grader.scenario: Mobile SIM card failure with 'No SIM' error following international flight
grader.notes: Stranded airport mobile SIM failure call handled by Callum. Customer landed at Heathrow with an unreadable physical SIM card. Agent diagnosed hardware chip failure and paraphrased accurately, but failed Empathy on two high-distress panic outbursts (including one in the final third), refused Ownership by deflecting the stranded customer to an airport retail vendor, and abruptly cut off the caller without resolution.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent verified registered mobile number, billing address, and 4-digit security PIN within first 240 seconds.
